experiment_template.research_question: Does event-derived task state improve native ContextBench evidence selection after recycling within the same cumulative model-token cap?
stop_conditions: Any projected fact lacks a receipt or tool-event source.
Any within-round intervention, task, threshold or cap changes.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells.

records.falsifier: The projection fails to improve frozen paired native span F1 by the development target, degrades file metrics or completion, creates false observations, or increases cumulative model tokens without outcome benefit.
records.mechanism: Deterministically project the unchanged task objective, confirmed evidence handles, repository mutations, test/search outcomes, and unresolved terminal requirements from receipts and tool events. Present the bounded projection only after local recycling; keep source recovery explicit and structured terminal submission common.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state representation after actual recycling, with structured terminal submission common to both arms.
records.statement: A compact event-derived task-state projection shown after recycling improves useful completion more than a source-handle index alone.

experiment_template.research_question: Can recovery deduplication reduce token use without reducing useful outcomes?
stop_conditions: False cache-hit or source credit occurs.

records.falsifier: Deduplication does not reduce cumulative model tokens, blocks evidence needed after a later recycle, or reduces native selection quality or valid completion.
records.mechanism: Retain the source-handle index but suppress already recovered exact ranges within an epoch and present recovery availability only after recycling.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state representation after actual recycling, with structured terminal submission common to both arms.
records.statement: Repeated historical recovery is the main avoidable token cost; deduplicating recovered ranges preserves outcomes with fewer model tokens.

experiment_template.research_question: Does the state-only intervention produce no native benefit?
stop_conditions: Arms differ in evidence access, task, provider policy or token cap.

records.falsifier: A state-only treatment improves native paired outcomes under identical tasks, tools, terminal submission and token caps.
records.mechanism: GLM already has sufficient observable source recovery; its failures come from choosing or interpreting evidence rather than losing process state.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state representation after actual recycling, with structured terminal submission common to both arms.
records.statement: The remaining small-window error is semantic task reasoning, so deterministic state projection will not improve native selection quality.

selection.reason: Round four exercised exact recovery 31 times and returned 46,555 source bytes, yet the handle-only index missed the quality target and cost 77,656 more model tokens. H11 changes the missing abstraction—task reasoning state—while H12 isolates repeated recovery cost and H0 retains the semantic-ceiling explanation.
